note: All 30 rows carry real frame-studied spans; no placeholders remain. 30 are localizer output that passed the adversarial gate as-is. The other 0 carry at least one event measured directly from the footage by operator frame-study; each such row has a `span_provenance` field saying which event was replaced and why.

excluded_no_event_in_source.title: A Site 3 Post Plant Flash
excluded_no_event_in_source.reason: LANDING: the flash pops above the hallway ceiling-beam lip at the top edge of frame. The only deploy evidence is a small starburst at 69.2 (frames.sh y_k04l.png, 68.6-69.8, frame-exact), and by 69.3 the player turns to walk. There is no bloom and no whiteout, and nothing else at the landing can be cut. The gate failed LANDING on it for the same reason.

excluded_no_event_in_source.title: Middle Flash
excluded_no_event_in_source.reason: LANDING: the author cuts to a different POV (Mid Catwalk, facing a wall) before the pop. A dense 60fps pass from the release to +3s finds no bloom, no whiteout and no lighting wash in the thrower's POV.

excluded_no_event_in_source.title: A Main Flash 2 Support God Flash
excluded_no_event_in_source.reason: LANDING: the flash pops behind the building roofline while the thrower walks toward the wall without looking. The only evidence is a small glint at the top-left of the wall at 209.9 (frames.sh y_k13l.png, 209.3-210.6, frame-exact). By 210.4 the view is pressed against the wall.

excluded_no_event_in_source.title: B Site 2 Main Peek Flash
excluded_no_event_in_source.reason: LANDING: the deploy is never on camera. The canister climbs over the overhang lip and the next shot is a different ground-level courtyard scene with the rifle out.

excluded_no_event_in_source.title: B Site 4 Support Flash
excluded_no_event_in_source.reason: LANDING: the detonation is hidden behind the B-site crate. There is no bloom and no whiteout from the thrower's POV, and nothing else at the landing can be cut.
